message: No detected untrusted source handling: Models and tokenizers are loaded from HuggingFace Hub via from_pretrained without pinning a commit revision, verifying checksums, or authenticating the source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only renames columns and thresholds label values to 0/1 but performs no distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection to catch flipped labels.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading and preparation code reads CSVs and concatenates DataFrames with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via `from_pretrained(model_type, ...)` without any hash check, signature verification, pinned revision, or restriction to a controlled internal source.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection of any kind.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a standard Adam with no differential privacy wrapping (no Opacus, TF Privacy, or DP-SGD usage).
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/validation/test splits exist structurally, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and only a single accuracy metric is logged without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: The forward method passes raw text directly to the tokenizer with only truncation=True; there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (logits) are returned directly from forward() without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation before use.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the model processes text input, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the inference path.
